jobDescription: What You Will Do Write technical documentation, including overviews, how-to guides, user guides, API documentation, release notes, technical support guides, product user guides, firmware/software guides, white papers, operational procedures, manuals, easy to understand user interface text, online help guides, video tutorials, and developer guides Organize existing documents, identify documentation gaps, and drive new projects while keeping a focus on customer needs Define documentation requirements and work with engineers to create and update internal and external documentation Manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment Edit, clarify, and enhance documents written by engineers Support agile delivery of high-quality documentation and content in sync with monthly product releases Collaborating with different stakeholders to constantly improve the quality of your deliverables Requirements What We Are Looking For Bachelor's degree or equivalent with practical experience in the software industry 6+ years of experience as a technical writer, editor, with a focus on software or workflow applications Experience with cybersecurity products is a plus Outstanding skills in writing about complex technical and business subjects to a variety of audiences Experience researching and writing effective documents for developers and architects Ability to conceptualize, and execute projects with a strong bias for action and the ability to prioritize/meet deadlines Experience writing and reviewing content in US English Excellent oral, written, analytical, and organizational skills Detail-oriented, with the ability to think and write in context with the target reader or product user in mind Ability to be self-directed and work independently, yet equally comfortable contributing in a global team environment Strong technical writing knowledge and information mapping skills Experience working in an Agile content development environment Experience in writing online help and knowledge-based articles Experience with web-based and mobile products Experience in content review and localization Experience with a markup language such as HTML or XML Experience developing video tutorials and gifs Candidates must have thorough knowledge and experience in industry-standard authoring tools including Confluence Candidates must also have the flexibility to quickly learn new/better tools that the team employs in the future

title: Principal/Sr. Software Engineer
jobDescription: What You Will Do Own the architecture. Set the technical direction for multi-tenant, globally distributed systems that process billions of security events. Make the one-way-door calls on data models, service boundaries, and platform primitives Solve the unsolved. Take ambiguous, high-stakes problems real-time correlation at petabyte scale, sub-second graph queries, zero-downtime multi-region failover from whiteboard to production Raise the engineering bar. Set the standard for design reviews, code quality, observability, and on-call excellence. Mentor senior engineers into principal-caliber thinkers. Build AI-native. Treat LLMs and agents as first-class citizens of the stack both in the product (agentic SOAR, threat reasoning, copilots) and in how we build (AI-assisted development, vibe coding, eval-driven iteration). Ship 10x faster without shipping 10x bugs. Master the data. Model complex security telemetry across relational, document, graph, vector, and time-series stores. Tune the queries nobody else can tune Wield Kubernetes like a weapon. Design the platform so a 10x customer load is a config change, not a rewrite Be opinionated, not precious. Pick the boring tech when it’s right. Pick the bleeding edge when it wins. Defend both with data. Requirements What We Are Looking For 10+ years building production software, with meaningful time as a tech lead, staff, or principal in a high-growth startup or a team that behaves like one Architect’s mindset. You zoom from a CRD controller to a customer SLO to a board slide in the same meeting. You design for 10x, not for today Deep distributed systems chops. Consistency trade-offs, backpressure, idempotency, partitioning, and failure modes are your native language Kubernetes at real scale. Operators, multi-cluster, service mesh, cost and performance tuning not just kubectl apply Database depth across paradigms. Strong in Postgre SQL or My SQL at scale, plus working mastery of a No SQL, search (Elastic/Open Search), graph (Neo4j/Janus Graph), or vector store. You’ve hunted down an N+1 at 3 AM and enjoyed it Modern language fluency. Go and/or Python in production; comfortable reading anything. Clean, testable, observable code is non-negotiable AI-native engineer. You use Claude / Cursor / Copilot / agentic tools daily to outperform engineers who don’t. You know where vibe coding shines and where it’s dangerous and you teach the team the difference Cloud-native at heart. AWS (or GCP/Azure) in depth IAM, networking, cost, reliability. Terraform is muscle memory Security instinct. Threat modeling, secure-by-default design, and zero-trust patterns are part of how you think before anyone asks Sharp. Fast. Hungry. You’d rather ship, measure, and iterate than debate. You work hard because the problems are worth it not because someone is watching
